verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public API with API keys that can create incidents automatically from CI/CD pipelines and other automation systems, and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so it can be driven headlessly without the UI. The pack shows no first-party CLI, CI action, or end-to-end CI recipes, so the depth of CI support beyond API calls is unproven. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action), documented CI workflow examples beyond incident creation, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Rootly API allows you to create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, internal services, or any external automation system.
To generate a new API key, navigate to: **Organization dropdown** > **Organization Settings** > **API Keys > Generate New API Key**.
Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when they’re generated.
Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
